payload.description: People reach hey.chattic.us only as an authenticated principal. Cognito user pool per environment with Google as the sole social provider; the SPA does authorization code with PKCE; the front door verifies the Cognito JWT and resolves a Principal. X-Tenant-Id is deleted from the client. Routing is default deny: a route serves an enabled member unless it is explicitly marked reachable by a waitlisted one. Includes the OpenAI spend cap and AWS budget alarm, which land first and cover development while the rest is built. Includes per-worker credentials, closing the open question at docs/DESIGN_CHALLENGES.md.
payload.title: Gate the app behind Google sign-in
